article.title: A High-Resolution Seismic Catalog for the Initial 2019 Ridgecrest Earthquake Sequence: Foreshocks, Aftershocks, and Faulting Complexity
article.scientific_question: Can multichannel template matching and double-difference relocation reveal the dense foreshock, aftershock and faulting structure that is missed by routine detection?
article.sequence: 2019 Ridgecrest Mw 6.4 foreshock, Mw 7.1 mainshock and initial sequence from 2019-07-04 through 2019-07-16 UTC.
article.catalog_relationship: The canonical Data S1 is a 34,091-event detected/relocated catalog; the later multi-million-row phase-arrival release is auxiliary and must not be counted as an event catalog.

catalog.scientific_purpose: Dense template-matched event recovery, differential-time association and relative hypocenter relocation for the initial Ridgecrest sequence.
catalog.event_definition: SCSN template events and newly detected template matches that pass multichannel correlation thresholds and the hypoDD requirement of at least 12 P and 12 S correlation-derived differential times.

catalog.quality_tier_detail: High-resolution template-matched event catalog with differential-time relocation; phase CSV is auxiliary.

construction_workflow.summary: SCSN routine templates are scanned in daily blocks with multichannel template matching; catalog and correlation differential times are combined, relocated with hypoDD and exported as Data S1 with calibrated magnitudes.

input_data.name: SCSN routine template events
input_data.availability_conditions: Template population and preferred magnitudes inherited from routine catalog.

evidence.note: 13,525 is an event/template count, not a station count.

input_data.name: Continuous seismic waveforms
input_data.provider_or_network: Caltech, USGS, UNAVCO and University of Nevada Reno stations
input_data.channels_sampling: 100 samples/s; 2–12 Hz bandpass; P templates 2.5 s and S templates 4.0 s
input_data.availability_conditions: Changing real-time station availability; exact station-day inventory not stated.

stages.name: Template preparation
stages.purpose: Build P/S waveform templates from routine SCSN events.
stages.method: Use daily scans, 2–12 Hz bandpass and windows beginning 0.3 s before picks.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Use available station components and preserve SCSN template identities.
stages.dependencies: Requires seed picks and waveform availability.

stages.name: Multichannel correlation detection
stages.purpose: Detect hidden events and measure differential times.
stages.method: Scan daily blocks and use summed and individual correlation thresholds.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Reject detections below correlation/MAD thresholds or outside differential-time windows.
stages.intermediate_result: 8.6 million correlation P and 15.8 million correlation S differential times (article).

stages.name: Combine catalog and correlation picks
stages.purpose: Construct the differential-time network for relocation.
stages.method: Combine correlation-derived and SCSN catalog-derived P/S differential times.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Retain phase/station associations and weights for hypoDD.
stages.intermediate_result: Article reports 6.6 million SCSN-catalog P and 2.9 million SCSN-catalog S differential times.
stages.dependencies: Requires SCSN catalog and detected matches.

stages.name: hypoDD relocation
stages.method: Run hypoDD with article 1-D model and retain events with sufficient correlation differential times.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Require at least 12 P and 12 S correlation-derived differential times.
Article warns that some residual errors may remain.
stages.dependencies: Depends on valid differential-time network and velocity model.

stages.name: Magnitude calibration and Data S1 export
stages.purpose: Assign magnitudes to new detections and preserve template magnitudes.
stages.method: Calibrate new detections to SCSN ML; factor ten in amplitude corresponds to approximately 0.831 magnitude units.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Keep SCSN preferred magnitudes for template events; flag mixed scale for comparison.

construction_workflow.final_output: Canonical Data S1 with 34,091 event rows; frozen three-day common mask contains 7,716 events. The 5,703,270-row phase CSV remains a separate pick-level auxiliary product.

evidence.locator: Canonical Data S1 schema and checksum

scientific_findings.statement: Template matching reveals more than 20,000 events beyond the routine SCSN template population and resolves complex faulting.
scientific_findings.depends_on: P2 Data S1 and article figures

scientific_findings.statement: Completeness changes sharply after the mainshocks because coda saturation and noise alter detection sensitivity.

benchmark_context.quality_interpretation: Q1 for dense detection and relative geometry; Q2 for absolute hypocenters and completeness because the catalog is mostly unreviewed and template-conditioned.
benchmark_context.recommended_role: Primary dense recovery, association and relative-relocation reference for the Ridgecrest short-window benchmark.
benchmark_context.comparison_or_baseline_sources: Compare with Liu Table S1, Ross SCEDC QTM and AWR only under the common mask; use SCSN/operational products as a separate baseline.
benchmark_context.valid_comparisons: Event support, temporal clustering, relative geometry and differential-time/phase metrics.
benchmark_context.caveats: Do not treat the phase rows as events; do not use mainshock correlation centroids as universal absolute hypocenters; retain the raw depth outlier and mask it only for benchmark comparison.

evidence.locator: Benchmark role and limitations; Frozen benchmark-window audit

missing_information: Exact station-day waveform availability and per-event uncertainty are not in Data S1.
Supplementary movies and any machine-readable station inventory are not locally parsed.

warnings: Do not count phase-arrival rows as events.
